incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 503 errors detected for /v1/generate in us-east-1. Error rate spike started ~1768512300. Paging oncall: @Jordan. Incident ID INC-1768512345.

Jordan (oncall): ack. looking at logs and traces now. I'm seeing a lot of failed grpc calls to runtime-host-3. grabbing heap/kv stats. will update in 5.

Emily (IC): I'm taking incident command. Jordan, can you confirm customer impact (percentage of requests failing + samples)? Also need a short status-page blurb we can push to status.redwood.ai.

Devin (SRE): quick check: last deploy to runtime cluster happened ~1768511880 (deploy-2026-03-15-runtime). Rolling back that patch on host pool is in progress. Command: `kubectl rollout undo rs/runtime-deploy -n runtime-prod --to-revision=3`

Jordan (oncall): rollback kicked off. traffic is being drained from runtime-host-3 -> will warm fallback variant (gpt-medium-quant) as an interim. Early numbers: failing requests ~18% of requests in the last 5m for us-east-1, p95 latency spiked to 6.2s.

Sophia (CS): copying in customer impact question for acct teams — which customers are affected? I can prepare a customer notification draft once we know scope. Any major enterprise customers in us-east on Dedicated pools?

Ross (engineer): quick note from runtime logs: repeated KV cache eviction + OOM followed by request aborts. suspiciously aligned with the recent attention-optimization patch. collecting traces to confirm.

Emily (IC): good. Jordan/Devin prioritize mitigation (rollback + route to fallback). Sophia — draft a short customer message for impacted orgs. Keep it factual + no blame. I'll approve before send.

Sophia (CS): draft below — please edit.

```
Status: We are currently investigating increased 503 errors affecting text generation requests in us-east-1. Our engineers are actively mitigating the issue and have deployed a temporary fallback model to reduce failed requests. We will provide updates within 30 minutes and notify directly if your account shows degraded traffic.
```

Jordan (oncall): rollback complete, new pods stable. Error rate down to ~3% in last 2m. Rolling full traffic back to standard model in 2m after health checks.

Devin (SRE): confirmed: deploy rollback removed the offending kernel change; memory pressure normalized on the pool. We'll keep autoscaling disabled on that node group for 1h for monitoring. Added guard: `runtime.max_kv_size=2G` to prevent runaway eviction until a patch lands.

Emily (IC): OK pushing status page update approved. Sophia feel free to send customer note to affected accounts (I can CC). Use subject: "Service degradation affecting text generation in us-east-1 — mitigation in progress"

Sophia (CS): sending targeted customer emails now to the five affected accounts (BrightApps, NovaDocs, AcmeSearch, Shopwise, Finly). Email includes short status + we offer a follow-up call if needed.

Alex (support): logged all incoming tickets from those customers as P1 and linked to incident INC-1768512345. forwarding any requested details to CS.

Ross (engineer): root cause preliminary: an attention-optimization change caused larger-than-expected KV cache churn under a particular seq-len distribution, hitting an eviction bug that triggered OOM on runtime-host-3 and produced 503s. reproducer saved at `s3://redwood-incidents/1768512345/repro.tar.gz`.

Jordan (oncall): handing off overnight to Alex at 1768513500 — Alex, you have the incident context and the mitigation is stable for now. Notes: rollback done, kv guard set, status page up, customers notified. Contact matrix in incident runbook.

Alex (support): ack takeover. I'll monitor alerts, keep the status page updated for any regressions, and escalate to oncall if error rate goes back above 10%.

Emily (IC): Post-incident follow-ups we need: 1) Short customer-facing RCA (1–2 paragraphs) 2) Technical RCA with timeline and mitigations for eng 3) Preventative actions + assignment + ETA. Target: customer RCA draft by EOD local (today), full technical RCA by tomorrow EOD.

Ross (engineer): preliminary technical RCA note:
- 1768511880: runtime patch deploy with attention-kernel v2.1
- 1768512300: first error rate increase observed
- 1768512345: incident auto-detected and page to oncall
- 1768512400: rollback started
- 1768512460: rollback completed, errors decreasing
- 1768513500: handoff to support

Planned preventatives: revert attention-kernel v2.1 in stable channel, add KV cache evict unit tests, add proactive mem-pressure alert at 70% usage, and a non-disruptive canary window of 30m before full rollout. Assignments: Ross to implement tests (ETA 5d), Devin to add alerting + canary gating (ETA 3d).

Sophia (CS): customer-facing RCA draft — please review:

```
We experienced an elevated rate of failed generation requests in us-east-1 due to an infrastructure change that increased memory pressure on a runtime host, causing some requests to fail with 503 errors. We mitigated the issue by rolling back the recent runtime change and routing traffic to a temporary fallback model while stability checks completed. The rollback has reduced failure rates to within normal ranges. We will follow up with a more detailed technical summary and the steps we are taking to prevent recurrence. We apologize for the disruption and are available for a briefing if you'd like additional details.
```

Emily (IC): edits: remove phrase "infrastructure change" -> replace with "runtime optimization change". Add line offering a credit if SLA impacted: "If this incident affected your production SLAs, contact your CS lead and we will evaluate a service credit." Otherwise good.

Sophia (CS): updated and sent. I'll add link to scheduled RCA doc once Ross posts the full timeline.

Alex (support): monitoring - no regressions in the last 30m. setting a 4h watch window then will update status page to "resolved, monitoring" once cleared for 2h.

Emily (IC): Closing notes for thread: keep assignments visible in triage board. Ross/Devin to post full technical RCA and remediation PRs. Sophia to deliver customer follow-up email + offer calls. Incident closed when technical RCA and preventatives are documented and shipped.

incident-bot: Incident INC-1768512345 status updated -> mitigated.
